title: Senior Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
Who You Are
  
  
You’re a curious, analytical finance professional who enjoys understanding the story behind the numbers. You bring a foundation in finance, accounting, or analytics, a careful approach to financial data, and the ability to turn analysis into clear insights. You’re comfortable collaborating across teams, asking thoughtful questions, and managing recurring deadlines while continuing to build your financial planning and analysis skills.
  
  
As an FP&A Analyst, you’ll support financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analysis that help the company make informed business decisions. Reporting to the Director, Financial Planning and Analysis, you’ll work closely with Finance and business stakeholders to understand performance, investigate variances, and improve reporting processes. You’ll gain broad exposure to revenue and workforce planning, expense management, financial modeling, and profitability analysis while contributing to the company’s financial and operational performance.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Support monthly and quarterly forecasts and the annual budgeting process by preparing templates, coordinating stakeholder inputs, and consolidating financial projections.
* Review forecast submissions for completeness and consistency, clarify assumptions, and document changes, risks, and opportunities related to revenue, staffing, and spending.
* Prepare monthly financial reports and compare actual results with budget, forecast, and prior periods; investigate revenue and expense variances and explain the key performance drivers.
* Partner with Accounting to reconcile financial results and research differences between actuals and forecasts.
* Maintain headcount, compensation, benefits, vendor spending, and operating expense schedules to support accurate planning and reporting.
* Update financial models, dashboards, and recurring management reports; assist with cost allocations and profitability analysis.
* Perform scenario modeling and ad hoc financial analysis to help leaders evaluate business decisions.
* Translate financial findings into clear commentary, presentations, and supporting materials for business leaders, Finance leadership, and private equity partners.
* Identify opportunities to simplify forecasting and reporting, automate recurring work, and improve the consistency and reliability of financial data.
* Support the implementation and use of planning, business intelligence, and reporting tools, and maintain documentation for key processes, reporting definitions, and financial methodologies.

What You Bring
  
  

* 1-3 of experience in finance, accounting, analytics, or a related role; FP&A experience is preferred.
* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Analytics, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis, with experience organizing and analyzing financial or operational data.
* Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in PowerPoint, with the ability to communicate financial findings clearly in writing and presentations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy, with the curiosity to investigate results, identify inconsistencies, and escalate issues when appropriate.
* The ability to manage multiple responsibilities, meet recurring deadlines, adapt to changing priorities, and proactively communicate progress, risks, and potential delays.
* A collaborative approach to building relationships across functions, with the ability to work independently on defined responsibilities and seek guidance when needed.
* Experience with enterprise planning or performance management systems, such as NSPB; data visualization or business intelligence tools, such as Tableau; or ERP systems, financial reporting systems, or data warehouses is a plus.
* An interest in improving processes and developing your FP&A skills; interest in applying automation and AI to finance and accounting processes is a plus.

**Perks And Benefits**

* Competitive Salary
* Health, Dental and Vision benefit packages to fit all types of lifestyles
* Life, Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance paid 100% by the company
* FSA / HSA Options
* 401(K) with a generous company match program
* Flexible Paid Time Off (aka- unlimited)
* Paid Parental Leave
* Hybrid and Remote work schedules available
* Employee Assistance Program (unlimited free telephonic counseling for a variety of issues such as mental health, financial support, and legal advice)
* Employee Referral Program

Unlock Health is a full-service marketing communication agency, grounded in technology, built for healthcare - and integrated with a managed care consultancy with deep revenue strategy expertise. We brought together leading healthcare firms to solve a core challenge: aligning brand, marketing, technology, and revenue strategy so healthcare organizations can attract and retain patients, grow brand equity, and protect their margins. --------------------

* Deal desk: Build and run one front door for pricing across our sales, partnerships, capture, and data acquisition teams, with a standard intake, approval thresholds, and an answer within an agreed turnaround. Give the commercial teams calculators and templates, built with AI tools where they help, so routine deals price themselves and the desk spends its time on complex ones.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Our client runs the compliant system of record you build on to move, store, and grow money. Launch financial products your customers love. We provide the financial primitives, licenses, and compliance, and our forward deployed team gets you live in two weeks. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there.

**The Role**

Our customers don't just call our APIs. They build their products on us. Their balances, their payment operations, their compliance state. Which means our business succeeds exactly as far as theirs do. Forward Deployed Engineering is the team that makes that true, one customer at a time.

You'll report to our CTO and embed with one strategic customer at a time, the enterprises building their products where we're investing deepest. You'll understand their business, their constraints, and their pain points better than anyone, and then you'll build what their launch needs.

Here's a concrete example. A global payouts customer is expanding into a new market where we don't yet have local account infrastructure. You scope the requirements with their engineering team, then build the virtual account infrastructure, in our core codebase, that their launch depends on. When it ships, it's not a one-off. It becomes a core product that we sell to the next ten customers.

That's the defining property of this role. This is not a services role, and it's not technical support. You're a product engineer whose roadmap comes from a live customer instead of a planning doc. Everything you build lands in the core platform, and the best of it becomes product the whole company resells. Engagements are scoped at contract time. You're delivering what we've committed to, not absorbing unbounded requests. But within that scope, the what, the why, and the how are yours to figure out with the customer.

**What You'll Do**

* **Deploy into customer contexts.** Iterate daily with your customer's engineering and operations teams, mostly over Zoom and Slack, with some travel to spend real time on site.
* **Scope the build with the customer.** You're not handed a spec. You work out what to build and why with the customer directly, paired with a deployment strategist who owns the commercial side.
* **Build across the full stack.** TypeScript and React, NestJS with Postgres and Prisma, and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda). New account infrastructure, blockchain integrations, API endpoints, compliance workflows, whatever the launch requires.
* **Generalize the bespoke.** Identify patterns across implementations and work with product to turn engagement output into first-class platform features.
* **Prototype fast, ship carefully.** Rapid iteration against live customer workflows, accepting some throwaway work and making sure what isn't throwaway gets productized properly, all while debugging production issues in real time, sometimes with the customer watching.
* **Design for correctness and auditability.** This is money-movement infrastructure. Edge cases have real consequences, and you think about failure modes before they happen.
* **Communicate crisply** with customer engineers, operators, founders, and finance leaders, and with our own product leads, whose pods your work must generalize into.

**Who You Are**

* **You're a builder first.** We're flexible on tenure. We'll hire a scrappy engineer straight out of school or a seasoned customer-facing engineer. We're not flexible on the bar. You ship production-grade, full-stack work, and you have something you've built to prove it.
* **You're AI-native.** Agentic tools are how you already build, and we'll ask you to show us.
* **You're energized by customers, not shielded from them.** You're comfortable operating directly with an enterprise engineering team, under ambiguity, where the requirements are yours to discover.
* **You're obsessed with correctness and resilience.** You love a good state machine. You think carefully about what happens when things go wrong, because with money they can't.
* **Strong pluses.** Payments and fintech infrastructure experience, blockchain and stablecoin integration work, and a forward-deployed or solutions architect background where you *built* rather than just configured.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Your customer launches on time, on our rails, and their volume ramps because what you built works.
* The infrastructure you shipped for one customer is now core product being sold to the next ten.
* Your customer's engineering team treats you as one of their own, and our team trusts what you merge.
* You've defined, alongside our CTO, what "forward deployed" means.
* You're an early member of a function we're building the company around.

**How We Work**

We run on three principles:

* **2% better, every day.** One percent for yourself, one percent for the people around you.
* **Telos.** From the Greek word telos, meaning not just done but fulfilled. Everyone here is focused on one mission and knows each other's Telos.
* **Build.** Embody the builder's mindset. Make things, solve problems, and have fun doing it.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, GES NA, Technical Vendor Management, Design and Construction
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you an innovative leader that wants to lead the cross-functional design and deployment of innovative solutions into our world-class existing fulfillment centers and logistics systems? Do you want to take ownership of solving the industry’s most complex problems? Does the challenge of designing and implementing ground breaking solutions for automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing appeal to you? If you’re looking to be challenged in a fast paced and often ambiguous environment, and you have strong technical problem solving and project management skills, then this job is for you!  
  
Amazon is searching for an innovative and solutions-oriented Technical Program Manager who is able to collaborate effectively with internal and external technical teams and be responsible for the design, development and deployment of our material handling systems across multiple building types. The role primarily focuses on the Technical Program Management of integrating systems and devices and delivering turnkey deployable solutions to be delivered in the field.  
  
In this role you will be responsible for working with internal customers to define highly ambiguous problem statements, influencing a global Amazon MHE sourcing and integration strategy, writing technical specifications and performing technical evaluations on equipment, generating multiyear budgets, driving project schedules from design to release, and managing multiple large, high visibility programs simultaneously through the project lifecycle.  
  
This person will possess a strong engineering and program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current MHE technologies and storage solutions. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an innovative environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done.  
  
This role requires 50% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own multiple large, complex programs through the full development and deployment lifecycle — you are the accountable driver from concept through field delivery
* Partner with internal customers to define ambiguous problem statements and translate them into clear technical requirements and specifications
* Contribute to Amazon's MHE sourcing and integration strategy by evaluating vendor capabilities, performing technical assessments, and generating data-driven recommendations
* Understand product integration requirements across mechanical, electrical, and controls functions at a systems level
* Critique and debate technical designs, assess viability of proposed solutions, and help engineering teams make appropriate trade-offs considering business goals, throughput, quality, maintainability, and operability
* Drive project schedules from design through release, managing dependencies and risks across internal and external stakeholders
* Generate multiyear budgets and track program financials
* Identify engineering standards and drive consistent application of changes across North America
* Synthesize complex technical and business inputs into clear documentation and specifications
* Lead weekly Team Leads Sync meetings — facilitate agenda, surface hot topics, and track open action items
* Facilitate bi-weekly Team All Call meetings, coordinating topic shares across the team
* Compile and distribute bi-weekly Lookahead/Flash reports covering highlights, lowlights, key meetings, FAT testing schedules, and vendor POCs
* Manage monthly document reviews, ensuring working papers are reviewed internally before leadership submission
* Support quarterly business reviews by compiling executive summaries, sub-pillar updates, FAQs, and appendices
* Prepare quarterly Big Rocks updates for leadership review
* Coordinate annual Charter/Strategy and Headcount Reviews, maintaining documentation in SharePoint and WorkDocs
* Support annual goal-setting processes and provide monthly goal update reminders
* Manage the Team Request Tracker — assign and track action items across team members
* Maintain and optimize operational mechanisms in Smartsheet and Slack to support team workflows

  
A day in the life  
Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Technical Vendor Management operates at the intersection of engineering execution and vendor partnership across North America. A day in the life may involve leading a weekly business review with a general contractor, reviewing scorecard data to identify systemic performance patterns, conducting a strategic planning session with your team leads, or presenting portfolio risk assessments to GES leadership. You will engage with vendor executives, coordinate with GPO on sourcing decisions, align with TVM counterparts, and drive cross-portfolio intelligence that no single project team can see. GES NA Technical Vendor Management is highly collaborative, working daily to make vendor performance consequential, vendor relationships strategic, and Amazon’s construction supply base stronger every year.

title: Director, Analytics Engineering
description:
#### **DIRECTOR, ANALYTICS ENGINEERING**

Current is a leading consumer fintech platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans with over 6 million members. We provide access to financial solutions that seamlessly work together to solve the needs of our members and enable all Americans to build better financial futures. Based in NYC, our results-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes.

#### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

As the Director of Analytics Engineering, you will be the strategic architect and hands-on leader of Current’s data transformation layer. You will lead the Analytics Engineering effort for BI and Analytics at Current, ensuring our data and analytics infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and deeply aligned with business goals.

This is a high-impact leadership role requiring a "player-coach" mentality. You will define the long-term vision for our data warehouse, oversee the execution of complex ETL/ELT pipelines, and serve as the primary bridge between technical engineering teams, analysts, product managers and business stakeholders. Beyond the tech stack, you will be responsible for mentorship, organizational design, and defining the career paths for a high-performing team of analytics engineers.

#### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and drive the Analytics Engineering and BI strategy. Own the roadmap and P&L for data warehousing, modeling, and business intelligence across the entire organization.
* Act as an engineer leading by example when necessary i.e. optimizing complex SQL, reviewing design, dbt models, data models, and troubleshooting high-priority pipeline issues.
* Lead the design and implementation of robust dimensional models, data marts, and aggregation layers in BigQuery using dbt and Airflow.
* Collaborate with leaders and stakeholders in different departments to translate business requirements into high-fidelity data models that power Looker and downstream analytics.
* Manage and grow a world-class Analytics Engineering team including an off-shore team. Define clear career ladders, conduct performance reviews, and foster a culture of technical excellence and data curiosity.
* Establish frameworks for data reconciliation, quality management, and security. Ensure the organization has absolute confidence in the accuracy and integrity of our data assets.
* Own the Business Intelligence tooling and frameworks
* Drive the adoption of data models, customer data platform, business intelligence tooling and reporting frameworks
* Collaborate with Data Platform Engineers and Infrastructure teams to implement and evaluate modern tooling for data ingestion, transformation, and observability, while also establishing robust data governance practices.

#### **ABOUT YOU**

* 10+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or Data Architecture, with at least 5+ years in a leadership or management capacity.
* Proven track record of building and scaling enterprise-grade Data Warehouses from the ground up. You have completed multiple full development lifecycles.
* Deep mastery of Kimball/Star Schema methodologies and how to apply them to modern, high-velocity fintech data.
* Expert-level SQL and performance tuning skills. Significant experience with dbt (preferred), BigQuery (or similar MPP like Snowflake), and orchestration tools like Airflow.
* Intermediate to advanced level programming skills in Python or other languages.
* Extensive experience building scalable data models and reporting layers in Looker (LookML) or similar enterprise BI tools.
* You are comfortable toggling between strategic planning and a terminal window. You enjoy being "on the ground" with your team to solve complex problems.
* You are passionate about mentorship and have experience defining roles, hiring top talent, and managing career growth in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong experience with cloud ecosystems like GCP or AWS.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders (e.g., Credit, Finance, and Executive teams).

#### **NICE TO HAVE**

* Direct experience in the Fintech or D2C domains.
* Experience managing distributed or hybrid teams.
* Familiarity with data mesh or data contract methodologies.
* Experience working with and managing a team in different time-zones.

This role has a base salary range of $270,000 - $330,000. Compensation is determined based on experience, skill level, and qualifications, which are assessed during the interview process. Current offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

#### **BENEFITS**

* Competitive salary
* Meaningful equity in the form of stock options
* 401(k) plan
* Discretionary performance bonus program
* Biannual performance reviews
* Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100% for you and your dependents
* Flexible time off and paid holidays

Enterprise Resiliency Analyst Lead

**Location**

New York, NY 10018

**Job Summary**

The Enterprise Resiliency Analyst Lead will advance efforts to establish and maintain enterprise resiliency practices at Flagstar. This role includes implementing the institution’s business continuity, disaster recovery programs and incident management practices. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in the business continuity lifecycle activities, including business impact analysis (BIA), strategy development, and testing. Hands-on experience coordinating or participating in disaster recovery (DR) testing is essential. The ability to influence senior leadership, coupled with experience in drafting policies, standards, and procedures, is key to success in this role. Knowledge of basic incident management protocols and business services frameworks is also critical.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide governance over all stages of the business continuity and disaster recovery programs.
* Lead the migration of business functions onto the new resiliency planning platform, Fusion.
* Establish frameworks, trainings, quality reviews to assist in implementing the business continuity, disaster recovery, and Incident Management programs.
* Develop and write policies, standards, and procedures for business continuity and disaster recovery.
* Lead scenario testing and simulation exercises to validate business continuity and recovery plans, ensuring preparedness for various operational disruptions.
* Stay current with best practices in business continuity, operational resiliency, disaster recovery, incident management and benchmarking the institution’s practices against industry standards and peer organizations.
* Provide support during actual incidents, ensuring swift response and minimal business impact.

**ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
* Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education level required: High School / High School Equivalency (GED, HiSET, TASC) / Foreign Equivalent.
* 7+ years of overall experience, with at least 3+ years focused on business continuity, disaster recovery, enterprise resiliency, or incident management.
* Experience with Fusion, Everbridge and/or Power Apps is a strong plus.
* Proven experience implementing business continuity, disaster recovery, and incident management programs.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Education level preferred: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) in Technology field of study.

**Job Competencies:**

* Knowledge of regulatory compliance and industry standards for business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management (e.g., FFIEC, NIST, ISO, DRII, BCI).
* Knowledge of basic incident management protocols and business services frameworks.
* Strong background in project management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex resiliency concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Specials Trading in North America is a part of the Fixed Income Financing business which sits within Rates Trading. The Specials business interfaces with a broad range of clients across hedge funds, asset managers, central banks, other dealers and internal cash desks. It is a multi-asset business quoting repo pricing across both investment grade and high yield credit markets. Specials Trading delivers liquidity to the firm's key strategic partners that operate in the North American Fixed Income Credit space via a team of dedicated repo traders and repo sales.

The desk belongs to the global FIF offering which includes Sovereign, Credit and Emerging Markets financing desks.

**Opportunity**  
To work in a fast moving trading role in the heart of the Credit Repo market. The main objective is to manage positions and risk arising from demands of both internal and external clients by facilitating their trading strategies. This is done by sourcing liquidity from bond holders to match up and lend onwards to a diverse client base and internal trading desks. These flows are quoted by a dedicated repo sales team, as well as via direct interactions between trading and relevant counterparties.

The candidate would contribute ideas and operate in both short term interest rate markets and credit markets, using a variety of products to mitigate risks arising from trading positions. The hired trader would work closely with multiple teams and provide commentary and market analysis, as well as managing the day to day flow activity and risk in our combined trading book. The last few years has seen significant progress in the development of e-trading and electronification in our business, and there is opportunity to assist with further progress of the business in this direction. **Job responsibilities:**

* Market making in US corporate bonds in repo.
* Managing trading risk and hedging positions in USD short term interest rate curves.

* Working closely with sales to facilitate client trading strategies.
* Engaging directly with multiple counterparties and interdealer-brokers to build business through meetings, calls, dinners and events.
* Writing trader commentaries on intra-day market analysis by investigating flow trends, macro news and leveraging internal research.
* Look to streamline desk process where required and help advance the desk automation and e-trading agenda.
* Assist with the post trade process by ensuring the accuracy of all bookings and to ensure internal controls are followed.

* Previous relevant experience gained within a similar Banking Markets role.
* An interest and a desire to learn more about global financing markets, rates and credit products.

**About Polymarket**

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform, where people trade on the outcomes of real-world events. As our markets, volumes, and derivative product suite grow, so does the sophistication of the risk infrastructure behind them. Our clearing and risk systems must operate with the rigor of a traditional clearinghouse while moving at the speed of a crypto-native trading platform.

**The Role**

We're hiring a mid-level quantitative risk analyst to design and implement enterprise-scale risk models at the heart of our clearing operation. You'll own models for market risk, volatility and correlation of derivatives, stress testing, and automated liquidation — the systems that keep the platform solvent and users protected in fast-moving markets.

This is a hands-on role: you'll be building models in production code, not just specifying them. We expect you to work fluently with AI tools for development and research — and to be the skeptic in the room, pressure-testing AI-generated models and code against well-established risk frameworks before anything ships.

**What You'll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale risk models covering market risk, margin, and counterparty exposure for a clearing organization.
* Build volatility and correlation models for derivatives, including calibration, backtesting, and ongoing model validation.
* Develop and run stress-testing frameworks: historical scenarios, hypothetical shocks, and reverse stress tests.
* Design and tune auto-liquidation logic — trigger thresholds, liquidation waterfalls, and safeguards against cascading liquidations.
* Use AI tools extensively to accelerate model development, coding, and research — and rigorously validate AI outputs against established risk models (VaR/ES, SPAN-style margining, GARCH-family volatility models, standard correlation frameworks) before deployment.
* Monitor model performance in production, investigate breaks, and iterate quickly.
* Partner with engineering, trading, and product teams to embed risk controls into platform architecture.
* Document model assumptions, limitations, and validation results to an audit-ready standard.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5–7 years of quantitative risk experience at a clearinghouse, exchange, prime broker, trading firm, or similar.
* Proven expertise designing and implementing risk models at enterprise scale — production systems, not just research prototypes.
* Deep experience modeling volatility, correlation, option skews, option pricing and implementing at scale for trad-fi derivatives, perpetuals, and fully collateralized event contracts.
* Hands-on experience with market risk modeling, stress testing, and auto-liquidation mechanics in a clearing context.
* Strong fluency with AI-assisted development and coding, paired with the judgment to pressure-test AI outputs against well-established risk models and catch what looks plausible but is wrong.
* Expert-level Python (numerical stack: NumPy, pandas, SciPy; solid software engineering practices).
* Advanced degree in a quantitative field (math, statistics, physics, financial engineering, CS) or equivalent experience.
* Strong mathematical foundation in stochastic calculus and linear algebra.

**Nice to Have**

* C# and/or C++ for performance-critical or production systems.
* Familiarity with crypto market structure, perpetuals, or prediction markets.
* Experience with CCP risk frameworks (CPMI-IOSCO PFMI, default management, margin methodology).
* Experience building real-time risk systems.

**Location & Work Setup**

This role is based in our New York City office, in person. You'll be working directly alongside the trading, engineering, and risk teams.

Compensation Range: $400K - $450K

This isn't a role that publishes a document once a year. — Classification Logic: Establish the criteria for how a market gets classified — and the process for reclassifying markets when conditions change.

Playbook Development & Maintenance

title: Junior Optimization Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Moxxi, we're redefining performance marketing with cutting-edge technology and a relentless focus on results. As a profitable, bootstrapped start-up, we are led by a team of industry veterans in performance marketing, ad tech, and digital publishing. Together, we're building the premier platform to incubate, scale, and optimize digitally born businesses, setting new standards for data-driven success.

Our entrepreneurial team brings proven experience from both global corporations and fast-growing startups. We're passionate about delivering scalable, profitable outcomes for our partners through advanced profiling, targeting, and continuous optimization. Joining Moxxi means becoming part of a growing start-up in the heart of NYC, where you'll have the opportunity to accelerate your career, expand your skill set, and shape the future of performance marketing.

### **The Role:**

We're looking for a Junior Optimization Specialist to support our growth product managers, account managers, and analysts in driving performance across Moxxi's portfolio. This is an entry-level role for someone who's energized by the question "how do we make this better?"—and wants to use data to answer it.

**This is a launchpad role.** You'll sit at the intersection of product, client services, and analytics, gaining broad exposure to how data informs growth decisions and drives execution. You'll support testing initiatives, surface insights from performance data, and help translate optimization opportunities into action. You'll also collaborate cross-functionally with design and engineering teams, giving you visibility into how ideas move from concept to implementation. Whether you eventually move deeper into analytics, product management, account strategy, or operations, this role will help you find your niche.

You'll work alongside experienced PMs, account managers, and analysts who will mentor you as you learn the rhythms of experimentation, measurement, and iteration. Your contributions will directly impact the metrics that matter most to the business.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Pull, organize, and analyze performance data from internal tools and platforms
* Build and maintain dashboards that track key growth and optimization metrics
* Prepare clear summaries of what's working, what's not, and what the data suggests we try next
* Spot trends, anomalies, and patterns that inform optimization decisions
* Support analysts with data gathering, QA, and visualization tasks
* Develop a strong understanding of the metrics that drive business performance

**Optimization & Experimentation Support**

* Assist growth PMs in setting up, monitoring, and analyzing A/B tests and experiments
* Track test performance and flag results that hit significance or show unexpected patterns
* Help document experiment hypotheses, methodologies, and learnings for the team
* Use data to support the prioritization of optimization opportunities
* Identify underperforming areas across funnels, flows, and campaigns and surface them to stakeholders

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with growth PMs to understand product priorities and how data supports decision-making
* Partner with account managers to connect optimization efforts to client goals and performance
* Support analysts in forming and validating hypotheses
* Collaborate with design and engineering teams on implementation of tests and product changes
* Participate in growth meetings, stand-ups, and retrospectives—sharing data-driven observations

**Process & Tool Management**

* Help maintain documentation for optimization workflows and testing processes
* Support the rollout of new tools, dashboards, or tracking implementations
* Assist with QA for tracking, tagging, and data accuracy
* Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve efficiency (training provided—curiosity required)

### **Who You Are:**

* 0–2 years of experience (or relevant internships) in analytics, marketing, product, operations, or related fields
* Genuinely curious about data—you want to understand what the numbers mean and what to do about them
* Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets—you can wrangle data, build formulas, and create clear summaries
* Detail-oriented with a knack for spotting things that don't look right in a dataset
* Strong communicator who can translate data into plain language and actionable insights
* Eager to learn new tools, frameworks, and ways of working
* Excited about using modern tools—including AI—to work smarter and move faster

### **Nice to Have:**

* Exposure to analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker, etc.)
* Basic understanding of experimentation and A/B testing concepts
* Familiarity with SQL or interest in learning it
* Experience with any project management or documentation tools (Notion, Asana, JIRA, etc.)

### **Why You'll Love This Role:**

* **Data is central:** You'll work with data every day to understand performance and drive decisions
* **Optimization is the job:** You'll spend your time figuring out how to improve things—not maintaining the status quo
* **Broad exposure:** Work across product, analytics, account management, design, and engineering to understand how growth actually happens
* **Learn from experts:** Get mentored by experienced PMs, account managers, and analysts who've built and scaled products
* **Career flexibility:** Build a foundation that opens doors to analytics, product management, account strategy, operations, or wherever your interests lead

**win together**
and

in our work.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Operations Management, or another quantitative discipline.
* 15+ years of experience leading workforce management, capacity planning, operations planning, service operations, or related functions.
* Demonstrated success managing multi-channel customer service environments and operational processing functions.
* Expertise in workforce forecasting and management, capacity planning, operational analytics, service operations, and process optimization
* Expertise with modern workforce management and operational planning technologies.

title: Member Care Operations Workforce  Lead
description:
**Mission**
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
  
  
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Great service doesn’t happen by accident. It happens when someone sees demand coming, plans for it with precision, and makes sure the right people are in the right place, at the right time, in the right way.
  
  
Neko Health is building a new kind of healthcare: proactive, human, and built around the member. Behind every call answered, every message returned, and every clinic visit that runs smoothly is a team that was in the right place at the right time. Right now, the workforce and analytics foundations that make that possible across our markets are still being built, and you would shape them.
  
  
As Member Care Operations Workforce Lead, you will set the vision and strategy for how Member Care Operations forecasts, plans, and optimises its people. That strategy will use data and analytics to anticipate demand across an ever changing mix of channels, and it will fit into our wider Operations architecture. All of it serves one common goal: to reinforce the Neko brand in everything we do and to exceed expectations every time. You will use AI and analytics to make it faster, sharper, and more predictive, without losing the human care at its heart.
  
  
You will work cross functionally across the whole of Neko, partnering with teams in every function and region. The scope is global, so you will need to hold one consistent standard while respecting the nuance of each market, language, and labour environment.
  
  
We are scaling aggressively, and this is the moment to get it right, before the gap is too deep to unwind. If you want to build something extraordinary, something members feel every time they reach us, this is the role.
  
  
**What You’ll Deliver in the First 6 to 12 Months**

* Build and maintain data driven global and regional demand forecasts across a dynamic, evolving mix of channels (such as phone, email, chat, and messaging), adapting models as new channels launch, volumes shift between them, and member preferences change. Factor in bookings, scan volumes, campaigns, market launches, and seasonality.
* Create capacity plans and schedules that balance service levels, team wellbeing, and cost across time zones, languages, and sites.
* Plan staffing for new market and clinic launches, from opening headcount to ramp up curves.
* Manage real time operations: monitor queues, adjust staffing, and coordinate intraday changes, including follow the sun and cross region coverage.
* Own scheduling processes (shift bids, leave, absence, swaps) while ensuring compliance with local labour laws and working time rules in each country.
* Track, analyse, and report on key metrics such as service level, occupancy, adherence, shrinkage, and forecast accuracy.
* Produce global headcount and hiring plans with Member Care leaders and Talent Acquisition, including onboarding and training schedules.
* Design scalable WFM processes, standards, and playbooks that new markets can adopt quickly.
* Evaluate, implement, and optimise WFM tooling, and explore automation and AI to improve forecasting, scheduling, and analytics.
* Build dashboards and regular reporting for leadership, using analytics to surface trends and flag risks early.
* Coach regional leads and team managers on WFM best practices.

**Minimum Requirements**

About the Agency:
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.  
  
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.
  
  
Your Team:  
  
  
  
The Office of Development leads the agency's effort in implementing the Mayor's Housing Plan. This is achieved in close collaboration with HPD colleagues and other City and state agencies.  
  
  
  
The Division of Homeownership Opportunities and Preservation (HOP) within the Office of Development creates and preserves affordable homes to facilitate generational wealth-building, maintain housing quality, and address the legacy of discrimination, segregation, and concentrated poverty. We do so by providing financial assistance to low- and middle-income homeowners, limited equity cooperatives, and community land trusts. Programs within the Division include:
  
  

* The HomeFirst down payment assistance program, which provides financial assistance towards down payment and closing costs for first-time homebuyers,

  
- The Affordable Neighborhood Cooperative Program (ANCP), which works to rehabilitate distressed city-owned occupied multi-family properties to create affordable cooperatives for low- and moderate-income households,
  
  
- The Open Door Program, which funds construction of cooperative and fee simple buildings to low, moderate- and middle-income families,
  
  

* Small Homes Rehab, which works to rehab existing public sites and privately owned 1-4 family homes to create affordable homeownership opportunities for low-income residents,

  

* The Plus One Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) program that finances ADU conversions in small homes,

  
- HomeFix and Project Help programs provide access to affordable low- or no-interest and potentially forgivable loans and grants for home repairs as well as resiliency or energy efficiency improvements to eligible owners of one- to four-family homes in New York City in partnership with nonprofit organizations,
  
  

* And special initiatives including Community Land Trusts, the Community Restoration Fund, and other projects designed to support long-term affordable homeownership opportunities through New York City.

**What is Bilt?**

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

  
  

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

  
  

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

  
  

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

**What’s the role?**

Bilt is building a payment facilitator business, which means we carry the merchant risk a processor would otherwise carry for us. Every restaurant, property management partner and retailer we sign is a decision about identity, ownership, business legitimacy and credit exposure. As our Director, Merchant Risk & Onboarding, you will own that decision end to end: the onboarding flow, KYB and beneficial owner KYC, underwriting, the vendor stack, policy and reporting. Our v1 onboarding flow will be live when you join. Your job is to make it fast and seamless for legitimate merchants, keep bad actors out, and make sure it holds up under sponsor bank, card network and regulatory review as we scale to thousands of merchants.

  
  

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. As the program grows and the need is clear, there may be room to add to the team down the line. You will spend most of your week designing and improving onboarding flows with Product and Engineering, and you will also review applications and transactions yourself and handle the edge cases. You will work closely with Legal, Compliance, Local Merchants, Payments, Fraud and Data Science, and with our sponsor bank and processing partners.

  
  

**In this role, you will own…**

* Own the end-to-end merchant onboarding flow for restaurants, property management partners and retailers, from application to first processed transaction, balancing conversion against risk.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to refine and extend the v1 flow, automating approval for low-risk applications and routing the rest to a clear manual review path.
* Run KYB: entity validity, registration and good standing, EIN match, address, MCC and business model validation, website and menu review, and licensing such as liquor licenses where relevant.
* Lead beneficial owner and control person KYC under the CDD rule (the federal rule on verifying business owners): ownership thresholds, document and selfie checks, sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, plus enhanced due diligence for complex ownership, shell entities and nominee owners.

* Select, configure and tune orchestration, KYB and fraud vendors against measured false positives, false negatives and cost.
* Partner with Fraud and Data Science on merchant fraud patterns such as bust-out, transaction laundering, collusive merchants and application fraud rings.
* Write and maintain policy and procedures that satisfy our sponsor bank, Visa and Mastercard payment facilitator rules and BSA/AML obligations, working with Compliance and Legal on CIP, risk assessments and exam readiness.
* Report on funnel and portfolio health — approval rate, time to approve, manual review rate, early-life loss and chargebacks — to executive leadership and to bank and network partners.
